mapper.insert: insert into ai_task_type ( task_name, task_code, description, preferred_model_id, fallback_model_ids, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{taskName}, #{taskCode}, #{description}, #{preferredModelId}, #{fallbackModelIds}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update ai_task_type set task_name = #{taskName}, task_code = #{taskCode}, description = #{description}, preferred_model_id = #{preferredModelId}, fallback_model_ids = #{fallbackModelIds}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, task_name, task_code, description, preferred_model_id, fallback_model_ids, created_at, updated_at from ai_task_type where id = #{id}
select id, task_name, task_code, description, preferred_model_id, fallback_model_ids, created_at, updated_at from ai_task_type where task_code = #{taskCode}
select id, task_name, task_code, description, preferred_model_id, fallback_model_ids, created_at, updated_at from ai_task_type order by created_at desc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}
